interface.name: wana_shell_control_v1
interface.description: This global is advertised only to the compositor-spawned Wana shell. It carries compositor-owned shortcuts to the shell and shell-owned window activation requests back to the compositor.

request.name: activate_toplevel
request.description: Raise, unminimize if necessary, and give keyboard focus to the toplevel whose ext-foreign-toplevel-list identifier matches.

event.name: toggle_launcher
event.description: Emitted for the compositor launcher shortcut.
